title: Express invoice totals
context: Express 4 routes for invoices. Line prices are integer cents; tax rates are stored in basis points (825 means 8.25%) and tax is rounded to the nearest cent. The discount applies before tax and a total can never be negative. req.user is set by auth middleware, and customers may only read their own invoices.
